purpose: Living registry of semantic vacuity forms discovered during proof-only cleanup. Extend this file when a new proof-debt-hiding pattern is found.

proof_carrier_field.description: A structure/class field carries a proposition, equality, witness, law, certificate, guard, socket, validity claim, or readback instead of proving an owner-side theorem.

proof_like_field_type.description: A structure/class field has proposition/equality/order/quantifier shape. This includes split proof cargo such as J_sq : J * J = 1 even when the field name avoids witness vocabulary.

carrier_witness_name.description: A structure/class name itself advertises witness/certificate/socket/guard/proxy packaging.

projection_reexport.description: A theorem/lemma is only a projection or direct re-export of a proof-carrying field/hypothesis.

trivial_surface.description: A promoted theorem/lemma has only a trivial/rfl/exact-True proof shape; may be valid for definitional lemmas but requires semantic owner review.

placeholder_token.description: A forbidden or open-debt proof token appears in Lean source.

dynamic_literal_definition.description: A dynamically named definition collapses to literal 0 or 1.

direct_alias_abbrev.description: An abbrev directly aliases another declaration and may be an expository wrapper rather than a theorem owner.

constant_function.description: A field or function body ignores input and returns 0, 1, True, or False.

identity_or_noop_function.description: A field or function body is syntactically the identity or a constant identity map.
